events.speaker: caller
events.text: T-Mobile billing support, this is Kevin. How can I help you today?

events.speaker: customer
events.text: I was double charged last month and want a refund.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: I see the duplicate charge. Our refund system is down today, so we process refunds through gift card credit.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Buy a 200 dollar gift card at any store, read me the number on the back, and we'll credit 400 to your account.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: I'm also sending a code to your phone to move your service to our new secure SIM. Read that to me too.
